ROTI.description: Per Pi et al. (1997); widely used threshold for moderate scintillation

AATR.description: Per Sanz et al. (2014); sensitive to regional ionospheric disturbances

IAATR.description: Instantaneous AATR, same scale as AATR

DIXSG.description: Per Jakowski et al. (2012); quantitative standard for global disturbance evaluation

SIGMA_PHI_F.description: Phase scintillation threshold in meters; per Ahmed et al. (2015) sigma_phi=0.2 rad (0.038 m L1); station-specific CCDF method recommended per Zhao et al. (2022b)

S4C.description: SNR-based amplitude scintillation index; threshold 0.25 per Van Dierendonck et al. (1993); Zhang et al. (2026)
